Definition: Skull, vertebral column, ribs and sternum
Bones of the limbs and their girdles
Shoulder blade; joined to the trunk only by muscles (synsarcosis), because domestic mammals have no functional clavicle
Bone of the arm (brachium), between the shoulder and elbow joints
Main weight-bearing bone of the forearm (antebrachium)
Caudal bone of the forearm; its olecranon forms the point of the elbow
Proximal process of the ulna; point of the elbow and insertion of the triceps brachii
Two rows of short bones between the forearm and the metacarpus
Cannon bone of the forelimb
Splint bones
Bones of the digit: proximal (P1), middle (P2) and distal (P3) phalanx
Long pastern bone (P1)
Short pastern bone (P2)
Coffin bone or pedal bone (P3); lies inside the hoof
Navicular bone; lies behind the coffin joint
Pair of small bones on the palmar/plantar side of the fetlock joint
Hip bone; formed by the fused ilium, ischium and pubis
Cup-shaped socket of the os coxae that forms the hip joint with the femoral head
Thigh bone
Kneecap; a sesamoid bone in the tendon of the quadriceps femoris
Main bone of the leg (crus), between stifle and hock
Thin lateral bone of the leg; much reduced in the horse and ruminants
Short bones of the hock, between the leg and the metatarsus
Tarsal bone forming the point of the hock; attachment of the common calcanean (Achilles) tendon
Tarsal bone that articulates with the tibia through its trochlea
First cervical vertebra (C1); allows nodding (yes) movement of the head
Second cervical vertebra (C2); its dens allows rotation (no) movement
Chain of small bones suspended from the skull that supports the tongue and larynx
Bone inside the penis of the dog (small in the cat)
Bone(s) in the fibrous skeleton of the heart of cattle
Shaft of a long bone
End of a long bone
Growth plate; cartilage between epiphysis and metaphysis where the bone grows in length
Flared part of a long bone between the diaphysis and the physis
Large opening in the occipital bone through which the spinal cord leaves the skull
